name: United Drilling Tools Ltd
moat_evidence: Working in a niche segment: holds API monogram licences 5CT, 5L, 5B, 7-1, 7-2, 19G1 and 19G2, plus ISO 13679:2019, covering oilfield casing, drill pipe and gas-lift equipment — UDT certifications page (udtltd.com/oilfield-equipment-manufacturers/our-certifications-and-licenses/)

Working in a niche segment: "UNITED DRILLING TOOLS LTD is one of the world's leading manufacturers of high quality products used in the upstream operations" — UDT About page (udtltd.com/oilfield-equipment-manufacturers/about-udt/)
research_note: United Drilling Tools Ltd (UNIDT, BSE 522014) is classed by Trendlyne under General Industrials / Other Industrial Goods, matching the 'precision engineering' hint; Screener puts market cap at about Rs 436 crore with ROCE 10.4%, and describes large-OD multi-start casing connectors, casing pipes, wireline winches and artificial gas-lift downhole tools sold into oil and gas drilling, with premium casing pipes recently commissioned in an Oil India gas well. The stack of API monogram licences and ISO 13679 is specific, verifiable and a genuine qualification barrier in a small field, which carries the niche-segment criterion. Flagged unclear because no India market-share figure or ranking exists in any source reached: the 'India's largest manufacturer' phrasing appears only in search-engine summaries, while UDT's own pages claim just 'one of the world's leading', and ROCE of 10.4% does not suggest much pricing power.
confirm_source: Infomerics Ratings press release, United Drilling Tools Limited, 05 August 2025
confirm_note: The independent document confirms the business and its financial health — TOI Rs 168.27 cr FY25, gearing 0.13x, ISCR 9.43x — but makes no market-position, leadership or share claim at all; its strengths are "experienced promoters" and "growing scale of operations". The API monogram licences (5CT, 5L, 5B, 7-1, 7-2, 19G1, 19G2) are objectively verifiable against API's own composite register and do establish a genuinely restricted, certification-gated niche. What is not established by any third party is the company's own "one of the world's leading manufacturers" wording. Left open rather than promoted.

name: Shish Industries Ltd
moat_evidence: India's leading manufacturer / working in a niche segment: "It was the first to develop and patent 5-ply Polypropylene Corrugated Sheets, created the reflective insulation product called Carmika, and pioneered insulated water tank covers in India" — Screener.in Key Points (screener.in/company/540693)
research_note: Shish Industries Ltd (SHISHIND, BSE 540693) is classed by Trendlyne under General Industrials / Plastic Products; Screener puts market cap at about Rs 444 crore and records 42% ten-year and 34% five-year sales CAGR. It manufactures, trades and markets PP sheets and rolls for protective packaging. Screener's key points carry a first-in-India-and-patented claim for 5-ply polypropylene corrugated sheets, along with the Carmika reflective insulation product and insulated water tank covers — a sourced hit on the leading-manufacturer and niche criteria. Flagged unclear because it rests on a single company-supplied claim with no market-share figure behind it, PP sheet extrusion is otherwise a competitive product, and the share trades at Rs 10.5: the evidence is real but thin.
confirm_source: no independent source found; secondary sites (Screener key points, TradeIndia, IndiaMART) all trace back to company copy
confirm_note: The "first to develop and patent 5-ply polypropylene corrugated sheets" claim repeats verbatim across several third-party-looking pages, but every one of them is reproducing the company's own description; no rating rationale, regulator record or patent-registry entry was found to confirm either the patent or the first-in-India priority. The claim may well be true — it is simply unverified, and a patent-office search is the check that would settle it. Left open rather than promoted or ruled out.
